title: Brutal!
description: Adds Ziglin Brutes, aka Zombified Piglin Brutes in a vanilla way!
body:
Welcome to Brutal!
 

Brutal is a small vanilla+ mod that aims to add Ziglin brutes, aka Zombified Piglin Brutes into the game. They can spawn naturally in small groups, as well as spawn on fortresses and bastions. 

 

Brutal also adds a couple quirks:

Piglin Brutes can now spawn naturally in small groups. 

Hoglins, Piglin Brutes, Piglins, and Horses all have a 10% chance to spawn a zombified version upon death. 

Zombies have a 10% chance to spawn Skeletons on death
